title: Image Annotation
subtitle: Box it. Label it. Export it.
description: A keyboard-first bounding-box editor that runs in your browser. Open your own images, label boxes and export JSON, COCO, YOLO or Pascal VOC.
longDescription: The original 2017 image-labeling tool, rebuilt with React and Vite. Draw and review bounding boxes with zoom, pan, undo and keyboard shortcuts. Images and annotations stay in the browser, with common dataset formats available for import and export.
features: Bounding boxes with class colours and keyboard shortcuts
Folder import, zoom, pan, undo and redo
JSON, COCO, YOLO and Pascal VOC import/export
Local browser storage and offline sample images
results: Static GitHub Pages app with browser-local annotation and export
